records.name: Conversation
records.purpose: Chat conversation, business or support route

records.name: Customer reference
records.purpose: Merchant-scoped pseudonymous customer reference, never the LynkID

records.name: Order

records.purpose: Physical companion card. Linked to its virtual card in the database, never by composing IDs

records.name: Evidence pack
records.purpose: Evidence pack for one payment or dispute (LynkProof)

records.name: Verified review

records.name: Survey answer

records.name: Supplier score

records.name: LynkSentry incident

records.name: Survey

records.name: Trip or journey
